name: Euler
plain: The plain first-order step: ask the model for the clean image, compute the slope toward it, walk to the next noise level. With the default churn of 0 it is deterministic and costs one model call per step. It is the simplest solver in core, and several other entries reduce to this line.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
d=(x−D)/σ̂; x'=x+d·(σ'−σ̂).
Optional churn before the model call (defaults off; no core node exposes s_churn): γ=min(s_churn/N, √2−1) when s_tmin≤σ≤s_tmax, N=len(sigmas)−1; σ̂=σ(1+γ); x←x+ε·s_noise·√(σ̂²−σ²), ε from torch.randn_like (global RNG, not the seeded noise sampler). All later σ in the step are σ̂.

props.prediction_space: σ (Karras ODE slope d, model output converted to x0)
props.final_sigma0: No branch: dt=−σ̂ makes x'=D exactly (algebra of the step).
props.flow_const: No branch. On CONST x=(1−σ)x0+σn, so d is the flow velocity n−x0 and the same line is the rectified-flow Euler step.

label: from code
surprise: Churn noise comes from global torch.randn_like, not extra_args seed, and no core node can set s_churn.
